title: NestedRoutes
summary: Render matched layouts inside their shared RouterProvider.

sections.title: Render
sections.body: Mount once below the router provider. Each layout renders its child through Outlet.

sections.title: Persistence
sections.body: An unchanged layout identity retains component state and input when a child changes. Revalidation replaces only selected loader values.

sections.title: Failures
sections.body: The nearest ErrorBoundary handles loader/action failures and render errors. It can read the error using the nested useRouteError hook.
sections.code:

sections.title: Pending work
sections.body: The committed branch stays visible during navigation. Request pending matches when selecting destination-specific loading handles. Initial module fallbacks apply before loader data is available.
